Mister Auto Final Demo
Objective
Build a modern automotive ecommerce website strongly inspired by the reference screenshots and assets provided in the repository.

Technology
Next.js 15
React
TypeScript
Tailwind CSS
App Router
Pages
Homepage
Vehicle Garage
Product Categories
Product Listing
Product Detail
Cart
Login
B2B Login
Design Rules
Use provided reference images as primary source of inspiration
Replicate information architecture and navigation patterns
Replicate layout structure and visual hierarchy
Create reusable UI components
Responsive desktop and mobile experience
Modern ecommerce quality
Technical Rules
Strong TypeScript typing
Clean architecture
Reusable components
No mock APIs initially
Local mock data allowed
Production quality code
Future Adobe Integrations
The website will later integrate:

Adobe Web SDK
Adobe Experience Platform (AEP)
Adobe Journey Optimizer (AJO)
Web Personalization
Cart Abandonment Journeys
The architecture should allow these integrations later but should NOT implement them during the initial build.

Important
Focus first on:

Homepage
Navigation
Categories
Product Listing
Product Detail
Vehicle Garage
Do not build Adobe integrations until requested.
